## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** 赫梯国家史高度依赖哈图沙王室档案，因此首都以外成组出土的王室文书尤其重要。Šamuḫa是赫梯政治、宗教和军事体系中的关键区域中心；如果Kayalıpınar泥板确属同一档案群，它们可以提供不同于首都视角的战争、行政、疾病、占卜和王室仪式记录。

**English.** Hittite political history depends heavily on the royal archives from Hattusa, making coherent groups of royal documents from outside the capital especially valuable. Šamuḫa was an important regional centre within the Hittite political, religious and military system; if the Kayalıpınar tablets form a coherent archive, they can provide a perspective on warfare, administration, disease, divination and royal ritual that differs from the capital-centred record.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 2026年发掘新出131块楔形文字泥板及残片，与2025年的53块合计184块，被发掘团队视为一组赫梯王室档案。初步释读内容包括高热疫情、婴幼儿死亡、王室成员丧葬、鸟卜、祈祷以及前线将领请求军队、马匹和战车的信件。

**English.** Excavations in 2026 recovered 131 cuneiform tablets and fragments; together with 53 pieces found in 2025, the corpus now totals 184. Preliminary readings include references to a fever epidemic, infant and royal death, funerary rites, bird divination, prayers, and military correspondence requesting troops, horses, and chariots.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 哈图沙以外保存成组王室文书的地点很少。Šamuḫa档案可能让研究者从区域性王室中心内部观察战争、疾病、占卜与行政实践。不过目前文本仍在释读，所谓“21世纪最大的赫梯语档案”等说法来自发掘方与官方发布，应在正式出版后再评估。

**English.** Coherent royal archives outside Hattusa are uncommon. The Šamuḫa material could provide an unusually direct view of warfare, disease, divination, and administration at a regional royal centre. At present, however, the texts remain under study and claims about the archive’s scale should be reassessed after full publication.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

**尚无同行评议论文 | No peer-reviewed publication yet.**

Hürriyet Daily News. (2026, October 10). *Cuneiform tablets from Hittite King unearthed*. https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/cuneiform-tablets-from-hittite-king-unearthed-227946

**现有资料内容（中文）。** 该报道依据发掘负责人Çiğdem Maner及土耳其官方信息，报告2026年新出131块泥板和残片，与2025年的53块合计184块，并介绍疫情、王室死亡、鸟卜和军事请求等初步释读。它是新闻报道，不应伪装成Koç University或文化部的正式学术报告。

**What the current source shows (English).** The report draws on excavation director Çiğdem Maner and Turkish official information to describe 131 tablets and fragments recovered in 2026, bringing the 2025–2026 total to 184, together with preliminary readings concerning epidemic disease, royal death, bird divination and military requests. It is a news report and should not be presented as a formal Koç University or Ministry scholarly publication.
